alt: A blue paper tile with a white letter W is pixelating into blue and orange square particles that flow towards an orange paper tile with a white letter P on a white surface.
caption: Paper icons for Word and PowerPoint are shown with particle effects on a white dotted surface.
description: A blue paper cutout with the letter W on the left is transforming into blue and orange pixels that form a trail leading to an orange paper cutout with the letter P on the right. The icons sit on a white background with small grey dots, next to a stack of blue cards and a green ruler.
